recipe.summary: 三条路线均完成 24.576M 张次 96px 训练；根据 seed3333 选用 20.480M 的 lr=1e-4 EMA。相同 guidance=3、同一早期 guide 和 Heun50 下，独立噪声 seed7777 的 FID 从 59.407 降到 55.563。末段部分指标回升，因此保留中期最佳 EMA。
limitations: FID/KID uses 1024 generated versus 1000 validation images, not FID50k.
Confirmation changes the noise seed, not the validation dataset; training seed remains42.
48px source image IDs are unavailable, so overlap with96px validation cannot be excluded.
The selected EMA is at20.480M; the full last.pt optimizer/RNG state is at24.576M.
